Code keeps its shaded background and syntax colors. Results appear separately.

```{python}
print('  <result>& "quoted"\n    second line')
```

```{python, echo=false, fig-alt="Responsive raster test image"}
import random
import struct
import zlib
from IPython.display import Image

width, height = 1600, 800
pixels = random.Random(42).randbytes(width * height * 3)
rows = b''.join(b'\x00' + pixels[y * width * 3:(y + 1) * width * 3] for y in range(height))

def png_chunk(kind, data):
    return struct.pack('!I', len(data)) + kind + data + struct.pack('!I', zlib.crc32(kind + data))

png = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
png += png_chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('!2I5B', width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
png += png_chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(rows))
png += png_chunk(b'IEND', b'')
Image(data=png)
```
